mapper.sql: select r.resource_id, r.resource_code, r.station_id, r.station_name, r.pile_no, r.pile_type, r.resource_owner_type, r.rated_power, r.adjustable_rate, r.adjustable_power, r.avg7d_power, r.valley_rate, r.valley_power, (select count(distinct d.event_id) from dr_dispatch d where d.pile_no = r.pile_no and d.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and d.del_flag = '0') as event_count, t.tenant_name, r.participate_flag, r.participate_status, r.device_status, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.tenant_id from dr_resource r left join sys_tenant t on t.id = r.tenant_id
mapper.delete:
delete from dr_resource where resource_id in
#{resourceId}
mapper.select:
select count(distinct station_name) as stationCount, count(*) as pileCount, sum(rated_power) as ratedPower, sum(adjustable_power) as adjustablePower, sum(valley_power) as valleyPower, sum(avg7d_power) as avg7dPower, sum(case when pile_type = 'DC' then 1 else 0 end) as dcCount, sum(case when pile_type = 'AC' then 1 else 0 end) as acCount, sum(case when device_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as onlineCount, sum(case when device_status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as offlineCount, sum(case when device_status = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as faultCount from dr_resource where del_flag = '0' and participate_flag = '1' and participate_status = '1'
and station_id in #{id}

select coalesce(tenant_id, 9999) as tenantId, station_id as stationId, count(*) as pileCount, sum(rated_power) as ratedPower, sum(adjustable_power) as adjustablePower, sum(valley_power) as valleyPower, sum(case when device_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as onlineCount, sum(case when device_status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as offlineCount, sum(case when device_status = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as faultCount from dr_resource where del_flag = '0' and participate_flag = '1' and participate_status = '1' group by coalesce(tenant_id, 9999), station_id
select tenant_name from sys_tenant where id = #{tenantId}

select s.station_id as stationId, s.station_name as stationName, coalesce(sum(case when r.participate_status = '1' then r.adjustable_power else 0 end), 0) as adjustablePower, coalesce(sum(case when r.participate_status = '1' then r.valley_power else 0 end), 0) as fillValleyPower, count(r.resource_id) as pileCount from dr_station s left join dr_resource r on r.station_id = s.station_id and r.del_flag = '0' where s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '1' group by s.station_id, s.station_name order by s.station_id
